title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social spaces and cultural experiences on and around the Case Western Reserve University campus, from world-class art galleries to peaceful botanical gardens.

cards.title: Wander the Permanent Galleries
cards.subtitle: Steps from the Tinkham Veale University Center
cards.notes: Explore over 45,000 objects for free. CWRU students also get free admission to special ticketed exhibitions by showing their university ID at the desk.
cards.short_summary: A world-class art museum with free permanent galleries and student-specific perks for special exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: The CMA's permanent galleries are completely free to all members of the public; CWRU students also receive free access to all temporary exhibits with student IDs.
cards.source_title: Discovering Cleveland through museums - The Observer
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday-Sunday; closed Mondays. Permanent collection is free for everyone.

cards.title: Relax by the Fine Arts Garden
cards.subtitle: University Circle's central park
cards.notes: Walk the paths around the lagoon or sit on the lawn. It is a popular spot for outdoor study sessions and photography near the museum's south entrance.
cards.short_summary: A scenic public park and lagoon featuring the Fine Arts Garden and the Fountain of the Waters.
cards.evidence_claim: The land surrounding Wade Lagoon near the Cleveland Museum of Art was always intended to be a free and accessible public park.
cards.source_title: Wade Lagoon and the City Beautiful Movement | CMA Thinker
cards.access_notes: Public park accessible 24/7; best visited during daylight hours.

cards.title: Hang Out in the Tink
cards.subtitle: The 24/7 campus hub
cards.notes: Use the open lounges, study booths, or the grand staircase. The building is open to the community during the day and requires student ID for late-night entry.
cards.short_summary: The central student union at CWRU, offering 24/7 access for students and various social spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tinkham Veale University Center is open 24 hours a day; during late-night hours (10 p.m. to 7 a.m.), present your CWRU ID for access.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students with ID; public access during standard business hours.

cards.title: Tour the Botanical Displays
cards.subtitle: Year-round indoor gardens
cards.notes: Walk through themed gardens and seasonal floral displays. Admission and parking are free for all visitors every day of the week.
cards.short_summary: A city-run greenhouse and botanical garden offering free admission to indoor and outdoor plant collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Greenhouse is free to visit, and open year-round from 10:00 am to 4:00 pm daily, including weekends and holidays.
cards.source_title: Rockefeller Park Greenhouse | City of Cleveland Ohio

cards.title: See Historic Medical Artifacts
cards.subtitle: Inside the Allen Memorial Medical Library
cards.notes: View rare books and medical instruments from the 1800s. The museum is free and open to the public on the third floor of the library building.
cards.short_summary: A specialized museum on campus featuring a vast collection of medical history artifacts and rare books.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Dittrick Museum of Medical History is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit - Dittrick Medical History Center
cards.access_notes: Open Fridays 10:30 AM - 4:00 PM and Saturdays 12:00 PM - 4:00 PM.

cards.title: Attend a Student Orchestra Concert
cards.subtitle: Free music at Silver Hall
cards.notes: Watch CWRU Department of Music performances in a restored historic temple. While tickets are free, you must register online in advance to secure a seat.
cards.short_summary: Free admission to university music department concerts held at the Maltz Performing Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Concerts are free, but registration is required; the series offers opportunities for audiences of all ages to experience inspiring live music.
cards.source_title: CWRU Music: Orchestra Concert | Maltz Performing Arts Center
cards.access_notes: Check the event calendar for specific dates; registration is required for free tickets.

cards.title: Explore the Glasshouses
cards.subtitle: Free for students via the Access Program
cards.notes: Visit the Costa Rican rainforest and Madagascar desert biomes. CWRU students get one free admission per week with their university ID.
cards.short_summary: A large botanical garden with indoor glasshouses and outdoor gardens, free for CWRU students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Free Access program allows students to visit the Cleveland Botanical Garden one time per week with a valid student ID.
cards.source_title: Free Access Program | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Student ID required for free entry; check website for seasonal hours.

cards.title: View Special Collections Exhibits
cards.subtitle: Ancient coins and university history
cards.notes: Check out rotating exhibits in the Hatch Reading Room or the central staircase. The library is open to the community for browsing and reading during designated hours.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library featuring free public exhibits and special collections displays.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kelvin Smith Library Special Collections Coin Collection is on view in the Henry R. Hatch Reading Room; KSL welcomes community members during designated hours.
cards.access_notes: Community visitors must present a valid government-issued photo ID to enter.

cards.title: Study in the Atrium
cards.subtitle: A central Case Quad gathering spot
cards.notes: Find a table in the high-ceilinged atrium or use the lounge spaces on the upper levels. It is a reliable spot for group work or solo study between classes.
cards.short_summary: A major academic building on the Case Quad with large open spaces for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: In the atrium, scattered tables make it great for group study sessions, while sitting on the upper levels are ideal for students wanting privacy.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on CWRU's campus - The Observer
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; card access may be required after hours.

cards.title: Walk the Cultural Gardens
cards.subtitle: A tour of global heritage
cards.notes: Stroll through over 30 gardens representing different nationalities along MLK Jr. Drive. The gardens are public, free, and located just north of campus.
cards.short_summary: A series of public gardens along Rockefeller Park celebrating Cleveland's diverse ethnic heritage.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cleveland Cultural Gardens feature over 30 developed gardens showcasing cultural contributions; they are free to visit.
cards.source_title: Rockefeller Park Greenhouse | City of Cleveland Ohio
cards.access_notes: Public park area; accessible during daylight hours.
